evidence.quote: Kathryn Hill will not stand for reelection to the Board at the Annual Meeting and will retire from the Board at the end of her current term. Accordingly, the Board will set the number of directors at nine, effective as of the Annual Meeting. All of the nominees are currently members of the Board of Directors.
evidence.note: Nine nominees all currently directors, plus Kathryn Hill who still sits until the meeting: 9 + 1 = 10 current directors.

evidence.quote: The Board has determined that Mr. Fauber, as the Company’s CEO, is the only member of the Board who has not been determined to be independent under these standards.
evidence.note: Same text names Bermudez, Esperdy, Forlenza, Hill, Howell, Minaya, Seidman, Serafin and Van Saun as independent (9 of the 10 current directors); Fauber is the sole non-independent.

evidence.locator: Corporate Governance, Board leadership; executive sessions
evidence.quote: Vincent A. Forlenza, the independent Chairman of the Board, establishes the agenda for and presides at these sessions and has the authority to call additional sessions as appropriate.
evidence.note: Independent chair Forlenza separate from CEO Robert Fauber (Fauber is the Company's CEO per independence paragraph); no lead director.

evidence.quote: Based on that criterion, the Board determined that Charles E. Bunch, Ertharin Cousin, Cees 't Hart, Nancy McKinstry, Brian J. McNamara, Jorge S. Mesquita, Anindita Mukherjee, Jane Hamilton Nielsen, Paula A. Price, Patrick T. Siewert and Michael A. Todman are all independent.
evidence.note: 11 names declared independent; McKinstry is a nominee, not yet a director (Mr. Booth served only during fiscal 2024), so 11 - 1 = 10 of the 11 current directors; the 11th, Van de Put, is not independent.

evidence.quote: Our Board is led by Mr. Van de Put, the Chair and CEO, together with Mr. Siewert, our independent Lead Director.

evidence.quote: eight of our nine incumbent directors have been nominated by the Board for re-election.
evidence.note: Nine incumbent directors (8 renominated plus Mr. Cooperman, who steps down at the 2025 meeting but is still in office). New nominee Mr. Grohowski is not yet a director and is excluded.

evidence.quote: The Board of Directors has determined that, except for Mr. Zubretsky (the Company’s president and chief executive officer), each of the directors of the Company and the director nominees has no material relationship with the Company that would interfere with the exercise of his or her independent judgment as a director
evidence.note: All directors except CEO Zubretsky are independent under NYSE rules, so 9 - 1 = 8 of the 9 incumbent directors (Cooperman included as a current director).

evidence.quote: The roles of chairman of the Board and the chief executive officer are split, and the chairman is an independent director. Mr. Dale B. Wolf has been serving as the chairman of the Board since May 2017.
evidence.note: Separate chair (Wolf) and CEO (Zubretsky, president and chief executive officer); no lead director, Romney is vice-chair.
